definitions.raw_cancellation: delta equals negative nearest note-handover scaffold exactly
definitions.public_smoothed_baseline: LibreSVIP public119-tap raised-cosine baseline; per-ms step signal and linear interpolation. Independent geometric approximation, not a live engine read.
definitions.leading_consonant_window: [note start seconds - sum(positive headConsonants), note start). Timing interpretation for alignment, not proof of phoneme voicing.
definitions.zero_tolerances: Numerical comparisons, not a classification of audible phonation.
definitions.missing_vuv: No serialized value at that tick; no assumed default or polarity.

limits: No original file write, synthesis, audio inspection or live project operation.
Raw VUV values do not alone identify live effective voicing.
Public baseline is a format-conversion algorithm, not confirmed current ACE engine parity.
Visible occurrences can duplicate source notes across separate trim patterns.
